decisions.reason: The DPA management software sits close to the firm's compliance support for agencies and has positive customer feedback, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret results and keep improving the tool.

The management platform extends the firm's core hosting and integrated tooling, is featured on the home page, and is central to its agency-focused strategy, so the firm can readily absorb and act on feedback.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a direct variant of the established offer on owned infrastructure, so the firm has the related knowledge to refine it rather than withdraw it.
